criteria.required_evidence: Same-run independently clock-bound server admission/wait evidence, sustained realized backlog and symptom/reversal evidence; intended rate is not a cause label.
Explicit supported-cause scope, adequate observation coverage and alternatives; zero queue samples or HTTP success alone are insufficient.
Exact offered bytes plus actual work and prospective mismatch limits; separate executions remain distinct and trace loss/correlation limits must be recorded.
Defer prefill diagnosis until exclusive GPU phase attribution and a validated clock/cohort mapping exist.
Assessor identity, actual blinding statement, criterion-linked artifacts, rationale and unresolved outcomes; lock through the existing reference store before scoring.

next_collection_requirements: enough actual completions for proposed latency windows
temporary lull then recurrence and an ambiguous/unresolved control
pinned disjoint calibration/development/confirmation corpora and seeds
